_comment: Synthetic, deliberately domain-neutral demo fixture. The platform ships no fixtures at FIXTURES_DIR by default (see docs/adr/0001) because real replay fixtures are recordings of work on one specific service. This one exists only so the end-to-end demo reaches a completed terminal state instead of safe-stopping at the coder node, and it is mounted explicitly by the demo compose override rather than baked into the image.

attempts.rationale: Demo attempt: add a small module and a passing test for it.
